changelog: THE COMMANDERS THAT HOLD GROUND GOT BIGGER. The Quartermaster, Bombardier and Iron Marshal now occupy FOUR TILES — one creature on one health bar, not a token drawn oversized. You cannot slip around something that wide, so flanking one means fully ENCIRCLING it: every open tile of the ring has to hold one of your fighters. Tiles blocked by rock, water or the map edge were never available and don't count against you, so pinning a commander against terrain is genuinely cheaper — pick your ground. This bites hardest on the Iron Marshal, since flanking is the shortcut past its armour. And swarming one is no longer free: mob a commander and it calls in a RELIEF FORCE that lands two rings out, behind whoever is doing the surrounding, so you end up holding the circle from both sides. Also fixed: the Sacred Wood, the Fire Swamp and the Spire were conjuring reinforcements out of nowhere — a deer has no radio, and those fights have no commander to play cards. And the run forecast now spots the rare Spire encounter instead of confidently promising you the act boss.
